gl:definition.gl:content: digital twin reconstructed from point-in-time attestations about the object, sampled when the object visits an attestor, in which truth is episodic and staleness between attestations is unbounded and undetectable

gl:notes.gl:content: Corresponds to capability classes S0 (silent, testimony-only) and S1 (passive authentication).
Trust rides entirely on attestor authority; the twin is testimonial by default and sensorial by exception.

gl:ref.gl:id: Passive twin → active twin: the paradigm axis
